first_full_probe.diagnosis: Only the eight non-default-map reset fixtures failed: calling start_practice(map) directly does not set UI.practice_map, which Reset uses. The corrected fixture sets the actual UI selection before starting. No production change was needed.

latest_toolbar_overlap_probe.source_delta: Toolbar Controls moved above the travelling drawer for both drawing and GUI hit testing. Actual mouse clicks were verified while their rectangles overlapped.

scope: Fresh compact toolbar and actual 0.26s upward/downward SceneTree tweens: monotonic finite positions, correct endpoints, stable camera/player/model/RNG.
Real BaseButton presses reach paused controls midway through opening/closing; economic callbacks reject them. Timing is measured separately without pausing.

Twenty rapid open/close cycles per map/resolution retain one panel and bounded tweens. Actual rapid BUILD, upgrade and sale charge/refund once; the pad reopens. Held Escape cancels safely and the next valid purchase works.
Actual contact damage updates danger without closing the drawer. Paid R repair and Escape remain functional. Rapid bed/door switching does not charge.
Reset during a tween frees the old panel and restores compact controls. Temporary transactions preserve permanent profile bytes and values.
All 12 currently registered cards are within the accessible drawer. The 15 planned target rectangles fit mathematically; the three future building controls are not implemented/tested yet.
limitations: No acceptance of expansion, typed combat, new defenses or new Hunters yet.
The corrected default full HUD test is prepared for final integration. Only affected reset/toolbar scopes were rerun here; the initial full probe is not presented as a zero-exit run.
Headless input/geometry does not establish raster quality or native Windows hardware behavior. D owns screenshots.
C made no production edits, changed no historical tests/evidence and performed no commit or push.
